notablePrerequisites:
Dockside Extortionist has a sticker on it.
Opponents control at least three artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Scampire by paying {3}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least three Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.
